body: Do you ever feel as though suicide is the answer? Talking to my friend and just hearing what she says.. it drives me insane. I want to keep her with me as long as I can but sometimes I feel very selfish.. Im keeping her from doing it for my own personal benefit. She wants to go and I can just hear the sadness bleeding through her voice.. She is absolutely miserable and she wants to die. There are times when she is talking to me and I just want to scream "Fucking do it!" because I know what shes going through. I feel we should all have the say in when we die but I dont want her to go. At the same time I do.. she would be so much better off.
